finance.expense-approval/uncertainty/no-.why_it_matters: This decides whether an expense can stall, be escalated, or be refused when only the submitter's limit covers it, without weakening the rule that nobody decides their own expense.

options.label: Escalate the expense to an approver with a higher limit, never the submitter.
options.explanation: Keeps claims moving while preserving separation of duties.
impact: submit-expense routing gains an escalation outcome
rule_claims: When no approver other than the submitter has a limit covering the amount, the expense is escalated to an approver with a higher limit.
An escalated expense is never routed to its submitter.

options.label: Reject the expense automatically with a reason that no eligible approver exists.
options.explanation: Gives the submitter a prompt, explicit outcome at the cost of manual resubmission.
rule_claims: When no approver other than the submitter has a limit covering the amount, the expense is rejected with a reason visible to the submitter.

options.label: Defer the decision and keep compilation blocked.
options.explanation: Useful only when the human is not ready to choose a policy yet.
